<parameter=code>
def gateY(fr):
    ys=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']==1:
            b=n['boundary'][0]
            if 15<=b[0]<=24 and 27<=b[1]<=37:
                ys.append((b[0],b[1]))
    return sorted(ys)
print('gate Y now:', gateY(current_frame))

    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print('click',name,'-> gate Y:', gateY(current_frame))

</function>
